title: Make implementer handoffs and review evidence enforceable
objective: Translate the PR-003 and EXECUTION contracts into machine-checkable task and handoff/receipt schema material, and demonstrate rejection of a claimed pass without a command result, a missing artifact, and a stale dependency SHA.
outcome: Every implementer PR arrives with enough evidence for independent review.

commits.subject: Add the task and receipt schemas
commits.instructions: Translate EXECUTION.md into machine-checked task/handoff schemas: base/head, owned files, dependencies, changed behavior, commands/exits, fixtures, artifacts, hashes, risks and next consumer.
commits.verification: Fixtures reject a claimed pass without a command result, a missing artifact and a stale dependency SHA.
